threads.name: Evolution of the Museum's Physical Space
threads.description: This theme traces the development of the Museum of Fine Arts' physical space, beginning with its founding location, turning with significant expansions funded by patrons, and culminating in its current status as a cultural landmark. The narrative highlights the museum's growth from modest beginnings to a major institution.

threads.name: Francis Bartlett's Legacy of Donations
threads.description: This theme explores the impact of Francis Bartlett's donations on the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, highlighting how his contributions have shaped the museum's collection over time. The narrative begins with the purchase of significant artifacts using Bartlett's funds, turns with the continued influence of his donations in acquiring diverse works, and pays off with the enduring legacy of his generosity in the museum's growth.

threads.name: Cultural Contributions of the 20th Century
threads.description: This theme examines the cultural contributions made to the Museum of Fine Arts during the 20th century, focusing on the diverse artworks and collections donated during this period. It begins with the acquisition of 'Negro Student' in 1934, turns with the donation of Indian Rajasthani art, and pays off with the museum's enriched cultural tapestry.
